fields.summary: Daily limit: customers cannot send more than $5,000 per day
fields.description: To reduce fraud losses, a customer must not be able to send more than $5,000 in total in one calendar day. If a new payment would take them over the limit, the payment is refused and the customer sees a clear message. Deposits are not affected.
acceptance_criteria: A payment that takes the day's total above $5,000 is rejected
The customer sees a clear error message on the website
Deposits are not counted towards the limit

fields.summary: Show the payee's name in transaction history
fields.description: Customers find it hard to recognise past transactions because the history only shows account numbers. Where the other account is one of the customer's saved contacts, show the contact's name next to the transaction.
acceptance_criteria: History shows the contact name when the account is a saved contact
Otherwise the account number is shown as today

fields.summary: Let customers delete a saved contact
fields.description: Customers can add payees (contacts) but cannot remove them. Add a way to delete a saved contact from the website.
acceptance_criteria: A customer can delete one of their own saved contacts
A customer cannot delete another customer's contacts
Deleted contacts no longer appear in the payment form

fields.summary: Block payments to your own account
fields.description: Some customers accidentally send money to their own account number. A payment where the sender and the recipient are the same account must be refused.
acceptance_criteria: Payment to own account is rejected with a clear message

fields.summary: Collect the customer's phone number at sign-up
fields.description: We need a mobile phone number for every new customer so we can contact them about suspicious activity. Add a required phone number field to the sign-up form and store it with the customer's profile.
acceptance_criteria: Sign-up form has a required phone number field
The phone number is saved with the customer profile
Existing customers are not forced to add one yet

fields.summary: Download transaction history as a CSV file
fields.description: Customers want to download their transaction history to use in a spreadsheet. Add a Download button on the home page that gives a CSV file of the customer's transactions.
acceptance_criteria: Download button on the home page
CSV contains date, other account, amount
Only the customer's own transactions are included

fields.summary: Text the customer when their balance drops below $100
fields.description: Send the customer an SMS alert when a payment leaves their balance below $100, so they can top up before payments fail. Use the bank's SMS provider.
acceptance_criteria: SMS sent when balance goes below $100 after a payment
Only one alert per day per customer

fields.description: Customers complain the home page is slow. Make the balance appear faster.
acceptance_criteria: Home page feels faster

fields.description: Very small deposits cost more to process than they are worth. Deposits below $10 must be refused with a clear message.
acceptance_criteria: A deposit below $10 is rejected
Payments are not affected
